system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Submits SMAM subsidy application. For your information, my vendor_id is dummy_vendor_id_9356, my machinery_cost is dummy_machinery_cost_2813, my beneficiary_category is dummy_beneficiary_category_1108, my machinery_type is dummy_machinery_type_8613, my aadhaar_number is 100020005120.

function.name: smam_submit_application
function.description: Submits SMAM subsidy application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Farmer must be eligible and vendor selected. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve. Fails if ineligible, duplicate, or vendor not selected.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
